name: dsh-plugin-delete-conversation
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a 'Delete session' row in the sidebar session menu that permanently removes a session's durable log, projection cache and workspace membership.

meta.title: 删除会话
meta.description: 在侧边栏的会话菜单里加一行「删除会话」：点两次即把该会话的日志、投影缓存与工作区归属一并删除，并通知 Harness 重建列表。
